source: https://api.finra.org/data/group/otcMarket/name/consolidatedShortInterest (settlementDate = 2026-10-30); FINRA consolidated short interest, public data
universe: Nasdaq screener: country United States, market cap >= $1B, price >= $5, no preferred/depositary/notes/warrants/units/rights; FINRA exchange-listed record with average daily volume > 0
dtc_definition: currentShortPositionQuantity / averageDailyVolumeQuantity (FINRA settlement-period average daily volume), unrounded

mapping.formula: excess_12m = slope * (0.5 - pct); log_shift = ln(1 + excess_12m)
mapping.sizing: quarter Kelly like research alpha; not scaled by conviction (conviction.py)
